result.markdown:
For most small companies, I'd recommend **BambooHR, Rippling, or Gusto**\. The best choice depends on whether you need a complete HR management system, payroll automation, or something affordable and simple.

Here's how I'd rank the leading options in 2026.

## Top 6 HR software platforms for small businesses

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall HR management)

Great for employee records, onboarding, time-off tracking, performance reviews, employee documents, and reporting.

**Best for\:** Companies wanting a dedicated HR system.

Pricing: Around \$250/month for companies with 25 or fewer employees, based on reported pricing.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

Combines HR, payroll, benefits, onboarding, IT management, and employee access management.

**Best for\:** Fast-growing companies that want to automate processes.

Pricing: Starts around \$8/employee/month, plus platform fees; modules cost extra.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Gusto**

(Best for payroll and HR)

Easy-to-use payroll, tax filing, employee onboarding, benefits, and basic HR tools.

**Best for\:** Small companies that want payroll and HR together.

Pricing: Starts around \$49/month + \$6/employee.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**
Affordable HR management with leave tracking, attendance, employee records, workflows, and performance management.

**Best for\:** Small businesses on a tight budget.

Pricing: Free tier for up to 5 users; paid plans available.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BwBSbYO2w6fmiCza1cBB8CDNPx_RGELihr60dseklDBbkuXDKzQOsxDktUEaDbD9eHSkNEPdSztx6z5L7KWxwVZH6jhtvniCjHZWiwmIza8fJetVNFNkUW8nWMsCjN0tGPj3-bOa13wJXpjw3ACWKyqTPuzFSlzhsqOQpRdXN0K27NHCCyfrXWBE73H0_NmY?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Deel**
HR administration, onboarding, contractor management, international employment, and global payroll services.

**Best for\:** Companies hiring remote or international employees.

Pricing: Core HR starts around \$5/employee/month.

[Deel website](https://www.deel.com/)

---

![Homebase Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of joinhomebase.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ONPs31_XAP2XsJBs3Eie1qwgyuurZU2xtkB45n63IU2mOmCOoAYejKgqUNvwLJpQL-m8_ulLsnIwjUgfiI4WF5j-tZkBh8f6GZwUhD2ecILOo9YLaThDdn8foDqSv6GukdJX7e1Y6DGttWLJtIJKBrbS-cL872eVJQ2r8lUE_O-eo573PPEMZiZEhnAyfs0F?purpose=fullsize)

Employee scheduling, time clocks, timesheets, team communication, and basic HR tools.

| Homebase | Scheduling and attendance | Best hourly teams |


## My recommendation

If I were choosing HR software for a small company\:

- **5–15 employees\:** Zoho People or Gusto.
- **15–50 employees\:** BambooHR.
- **50–100 employees\:** Rippling or BambooHR.
- **Remote international employees\:** Deel.

One important consideration: if your company is in Canada, make sure the software supports Canadian payroll, provincial employment requirements, tax deductions, and benefits administration. US-focused payroll products aren't automatically suitable for Canadian businesses.
